about: shadcn's theme names, which agents write from habit and which generate no CSS in Ledger, each with the Ledger class for the same job. `means` finishes "shadcn's …"; `use` holds one class, or two with `for` saying when each fits; `aside` is a sentence the finding adds; `states` names the class for the name under a state variant, `selected` (a selected, checked or pressed item) or `placeholder`; `suggest: false` keeps a class that does another job from being offered as a replacement. build/lint-data.mjs checks every entry (each name generates no CSS and is no Ledger class, each class is one utilities.json lists) and writes the table into src/generated/lint-values.json, where ledger/no-non-token-class reads it; build/lint-docs.mjs writes it onto the Coming from shadcn page. After an edit run npm run build:tokens, then npm run build:lint.

bg-accent.aside: Ledger's accent-* colours are hues with no meaning.

bg-border.aside: A line between items is Separator, or a border side such as border-t.

text-primary-foreground.means: text colour on the primary background

text-secondary-foreground.means: text colour on the secondary background

text-accent-foreground.means: text colour on a hovered item
text-accent-foreground.aside: Ledger's accent-* colours are hues with no meaning.

text-destructive-foreground.means: text colour on the destructive background

fill-foreground.means: text colour as an SVG fill
fill-foreground.aside: An SVG takes its text colour through fill-current, beside a text-* token.

ring-offset-background.means: colour between a control and its focus ring
ring-offset-background.aside: The focus outline sets its own offset.

bg-sidebar.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.

text-sidebar-foreground.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.

bg-sidebar-accent.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.

text-sidebar-accent-foreground.means: text colour on a hovered sidebar item
text-sidebar-accent-foreground.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.

bg-sidebar-primary.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.

text-sidebar-primary-foreground.means: text colour on the sidebar primary background
text-sidebar-primary-foreground.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.

border-sidebar-border.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.

bg-sidebar-border.means: sidebar border colour as a fill
bg-sidebar-border.aside: A line between items is Separator, or a border side such as border-t.

ring-sidebar-ring.aside: Shell.SideNav is the side navigation and sets its own colours.
